title: Receipt with tax
prompt: Print a receipt for these items (name, price per unit in cents, quantity): apple 125 3, bread 399 1, milk 89 12, cheese 1450 2. Print one line per item, in this order, made of the name left-aligned in a field of 8 characters followed by the item total (price times quantity, in cents) written as dollars and cents with exactly two digits after the point (1205 cents is written 12.05) right-aligned in a field of 8 characters. Then print three more lines in the same layout, labelled `subtotal` (the sum of the item totals), `tax` and `total`. The tax is 8.25 percent of the subtotal rounded half up to a whole number of cents: compute it with integers as (subtotal * 825 + 5000) divided by 10000, discarding the remainder. The total is the subtotal plus the tax. Do not print trailing spaces.
expected_output:
apple       3.75
bread       3.99
milk       10.68
cheese     29.00
subtotal   47.42
tax         3.91
total      51.33
